# How to build and run the reference engine, for differential tests only.
#
# The reference's build file, target, binary and environment carry its name, so
# they live in this data file, excluded from the provenance scan, and the scripts
# read keys from here. Nothing built from these is committed or shipped: the
# reference is built outside the tree, from the pinned checkout, and only its
# output is compared with ours.
#
# One entry per line: key, tab, value.

build_file	Makefile.cbm
build_target	cbm
build_dir_variable	BUILD_DIR
extra_flags_variable	CFLAGS_EXTRA
binary	codebase-memory-mcp
cache_variable	CBM_CACHE_DIR
index_arguments	cli --quiet index_repository

# The engine differential (scripts/engine/differential.py) runs the reference with its
# process environment emptied of the reference's own variables, and with a language
# for every file's extension in its global configuration, so it reads each file as
# this project's language matrix does; both live in a configuration directory of the
# harness's own, never the user's.
environment_prefix	CBM_
language_config	codebase-memory-mcp/config.json
language_config_key	extra_extensions
